facts.fact: The Liberian Observer reports a US$52 million Build-Operate-Transfer concession agreement with OeSD International GmbH, signed per NIR's Andrew Peters in September 2026 and awaiting legislative ratification, under which the concessionaire is to finance, develop and operate a national biometric identification and civil registration system.
facts.system: National Identification and Biometric System concession

note: Concession not yet ratified; nothing in service.
